cd /app/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess
def run(req):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(req).encode(), capture_output=True)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
# atoms 0 and 1 are identical ASTs -> clauses {0} and {1} in one class, members=2
req = {"version":1,"window":1,
 "schema":[{"name":"f","type":"FLAG"},{"name":"g","type":"FLAG"}],
 "atoms":[{"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}},
          {"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}},
          {"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"g","at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}}],
 "policy":{"max_width":1,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},
 "train":[{"id":"t","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True,True]},{"t":1,"values":[True,True]}]}],
 "probes":[{"id":"p","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[False,False]}]}],
 "queries":[{"id":"q","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[False,True]}]},
            {"id":"q2","source":"s","rows":[{"t":0,"values":[True,False]}]}]}
r = run(req)
print(json.dumps(r, separators=(',',':')))
# expectations: literals f+(a0), f+(a1), g+(a2) all true on both train ctx -> eligible singletons
# all false on probe -> one class, members=3
# query1: f=False -> clauses {a0},{a1} false; {a2} true -> must=1, may=1 violating
# query2: f=True,g=False -> {a2} false -> must=1 may=1 violating
assert [c['members'] for c in r['classes']] == [3], r['classes']
assert [c['signature'] for c in r['classes']] == ['0']
assert [(q['must'],q['may'],q['status']) for q in r['queries']] == [(1,1,'violating'),(1,1,'violating')], r['queries']
print('OK: duplicate atoms share one class; all members evaluated')
PYEOF
